hypotheses.claim: At fixed small-model context, an ancestry/conflict-aware prepared ActiveAssembly preserves decision-relevant counterevidence and provenance better than pure relevance top-k while reducing redundant shared-ancestry context.
hypotheses.support: Hosted reference component: 5000 constructed echo/conflict trials retained counterevidence 5000/5000 versus 4212/5000 for naive top-3.
counterhypotheses: MMR/diversity-aware retrieval without explicit ancestry identity is sufficient
broad retrieval/cache preserves rare details well enough to dominate prepared Assembly
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched frozen H1 traces show no task-quality/provenance/conflict benefit, or prepared Assembly increases catastrophic omission/update cost enough to lose the Pareto comparison.

hypotheses.claim: Stable re-expansion references let the local 4B operate on a bounded Assembly without irreversibly losing omitted detail.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Re-expansion latency/staleness destroys the benefit and a larger direct context is superior.
hypotheses.falsifier: Long-horizon H1 traces show material recovery/correction failure or latency from omitted-detail re-expansion at matched context budget.

hypotheses.claim: Ancestry identity belongs in the selection plane but must not itself become truth weight; one-family caps should be policy/versioned rather than canonical constants.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Source-quality calibration alone is sufficient and ancestry caps suppress legitimate repeated evidence.
hypotheses.falsifier: Independent-source controlled trials show ancestry caps systematically reduce accuracy/calibration versus calibrated source weighting without meaningful echo protection.

hypotheses.claim: Residual-pressure/progress-aware recurrence is only admissible when the residual estimator has explicit identity, version, uncertainty and freshness; noisy/stale readouts can recreate false convergence.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Fixed budgets/event-driven orchestration dominate once readout calibration and controller overhead are included.
hypotheses.falsifier: Frozen H1 trajectory tests show no verified outcome-per-compute gain versus simpler baselines.

hypotheses.claim: Ordinary persistent event-driven orchestration plus compact retrieval/cache and deterministic effect authority can deliver equivalent useful FRANK behavior with less recurrence/topology/Assembly machinery.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched H1 experiments show reproducible incremental outcome/cost/recovery benefit from the richer mechanisms.
